title: symphyostemon biflorus
intro: Symphyostemon biflorus, commonly known as the "Bilobed Flower", is a plant species within the family Achariaceae. Bioactive constituents of Symphyostemon biflorus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
